record.name: MongoDB Atlas
record.one_liner: A cloud-hosted multi-cloud database service with programmatic management capabilities.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free tier account and generate service accounts or API keys in the Atlas UI.
record.api_note: The Atlas Administration API and CLI cover administration, infrastructure deployment, clusters, users, and projects.

evidence.quote: We recommend you use service accounts instead of API (Application Programming Interface) keys to authenticate to the Atlas Administration API.
In Atlas, go to the Applications page.
Atlas Administration API resources add, edit, or delete administrative objects within Atlas, including projects, users, and clusters.

auth.why: Docs recommend service accounts over API keys as primary auth.

mcp.why: GitHub page labels it the Official MongoDB MCP Server.
